purpose.en: One shared daily class. Handstand practice comes first on every training day and human-flag practice once or twice a week, never on consecutive days, in a few short, easy sets right after the warm-up. Doses rise in three steps inside each level and halve in deload weeks. The original-source blocks add pike push-ups twice a week. These are practice opportunities, never deadlines.

early_projection_purpose: Ordered rules for the working projection (training_content) of the original-source classes L1:001-040, L2:041-070 and L3:001-020; the original content stays for audit. The first project_exercise rule that matches an exercise replaces it with a library movement and its easier rung; otherwise each set takes the first project_set or keep rule that matches it. A keep rule names the library movement that has prepared the step by that class ('entry' for entry-level steps in Level 1). Field matching, class ranges and doses are described in tools/assemble_curriculum.ps1.
